title: To extend the deadline for the submittal of the final report required by the Commission on Care.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the House passed version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 1) This bill amends the Veterans Access, Choice, and Accountability Act of 2014 to extend the deadline for the Commission on Care's final report to June 30, 2016. (The Commission is charged with examining veterans' access to Department of Veterans Affairs health care and to examine how best to organize the Veterans Health Administration, locate health resources, and deliver health care to veterans during the next 20 years.)

summary.headline: This law pushes back the deadline for the Commission on Care to submit its final report on veterans' health care to June 30, 2016.
summary.what_it_does: The law changes the Veterans Access, Choice, and Accountability Act of 2014 by extending the date by which the Commission on Care must deliver its final report. The Commission studies how veterans get care from the Department of Veterans Affairs and how the VA's health system should be organized and staffed over the next 20 years. The change gives the Commission more time to finish that work.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who use VA health care
who_it_affects.how: The Commission's recommendations on how VA health care should be delivered will arrive later than originally scheduled.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Commission on Care
who_it_affects.how: They receive an extended deadline to complete and submit their final report.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted February 29, 2016; the new report deadline is June 30, 2016.
